$comment: HAND-AUTHORED — the register of PARKED-WITH-A-TRIPWIRE items (knowledge/_parked.py reads it, never writes it).
Born #269 2026-09-13 on Dave's word: 'store them for future sake, can they be triggered, or can we have a hook so they don't get missed at the appropriate time'.
A row is added when Dave parks something; its status moves to enacted/dropped by hand when he rules. Rows are never deleted — history is data.

Trigger kinds: pack-version-bump (due when _release/_pack_manifest.json version ≠ parked.at_version) · file-changed {path} (due when the path has a commit after parked.at_commit) · event {name} (due when that moment asks: --due <name>).

items.what: Phrase-aware RANKING in the search door — score a record higher when the query's words are ADJACENT (word bigrams via knowledge/_ngram.py), so 'six weeks' (5 verbatim) outranks 'six … weeks' (49 loose).
items.why: _search_core.py / _memento_search.py are pinned byte-identical to the memento-package by _validate_package_delta.py — a change is a pack change, therefore a RELEASE, therefore Dave's, and not before the David Rice demo. Research: _RESEARCH-ngram-lookups-2026-09-13-v1.html use 2.
items.owner: Dave (release); a lane builds once ruled

items.what: Typo tolerance in the search door — map a misspelt query word to the corpus's real word (knowledge/_ngram.py Vocabulary.nearest: 'ratifed' → 'ratified') before search runs, with the substitution shown in the receipt.
items.why: Same pin as P-269-1 — the door ships in the pack. The 'did you mean' already lives in _quote_gate.py; this is the same lookup moved into retrieval. Research use 3.
items.owner: Dave (release); a lane builds once ruled

items.what: KG edge candidates carry a measured shingle-overlap score (knowledge/_ngram.py shingles + jaccard) so proposed edges reach Dave RANKED by evidence, not bare.
items.why: At #267, 52 of 78 generated edges were wrong. Advisory ranking only — it never generates or ratifies an edge, and gen_kg_edges.py stays fenced behind lane-E RSQ 2. Research use 5. Due the next time the edge file moves.
